cards.name: Maneater
cards.text: Chaos (2 turns): Burn chance = (5 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A terrifying entity draped in tattered, shadow-woven shrouds, the Maneater is a parasitic nightmare that consumes both the flesh and the identities of its prey. It wraps its numerous hands around a broken man, absorbing his final, despairing thoughts as it pulls him entirely into the dark void of its cloak.

cards.name: Velvetblood
cards.text: Spy: Play on enemy side. Draw 1 card, steal 1 from their deck.
cards.background: A lethal scout and tracker for the Horde of the Carrion, Velvetblood moves silently through the damp, moss-grown forests. Clad in dark, weathered leathers with a hood pulled low, she draws her bow with practiced precision, accompanied by her ominous raven familiars that scout the paths ahead for fresh plunder.

cards.name: Calystria
cards.text: On Reveal: Destroy the highest enemy card here if their total is > 10.
cards.background: A high-ranking arbiter and mystic of the Elarion Empire, Calystria wears gleaming steel plate armor and a royal crown. Blindfolded to symbolize impartial, divine justice, she wields the scales of judgment in one hand while summoning pure, radiant cosmic energy in the other to pass absolute judgment upon her foes.

cards.name: Pothead
cards.text: Medic: Resurrect a destroyed or discarded non-Hero card to this location.
cards.background: An aged, ragged alchemist and herbalist serving the Horde, Pothead is known across the war camps for brewing foul concoctions and volatile potions. Surrounded by glowing-eyed ravens under the moonlight, he carries vials of strange liquids strapped to his frame, extracting dark secrets from the ruins.

cards.name: Ancient Chitterswarm
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A colossal, bat-like monstrosity of ancient lineage, the Chitterswarm descends from the high clouds on tattered, blood-red wings. Exhibiting rows of jagged, dripping fangs and rabid yellow eyes, it hunts solitary travelers and vanguard scouts, plunging dark forests into terror.

cards.name: Vaelthar
cards.text: Chaos (1 turn): Burn chance = (12 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: An apocalyptic dragon of pure, scorching magma, Vaelthar represents total devastation. Its scales burn with internal fire, and its colossal weight shatters ancient barriers as it unleashes torrents of flame upon armies foolish enough to stand in its path.

cards.name: Anastasia
cards.text: On Reveal: Give all enemy cards at this location -1 Power.
cards.background: A battle-scarred and fiercely powerful tempest-mage within the Horde, Anastasia bears the physical trauma of past magical blowback, with jagged scars running across her face. Leaping through shattered earth, she channels wild, crackling yellow lightning from both hands, turning battlefields into electric craters.

cards.name: Thaldrak
cards.text: Move: Move one of your cards from another location to this one.
cards.background: A wandering mystic of mysterious origin, Thaldrak hides his face beneath a heavy traveling hood while carrying an ornate staff topped with a glowing sphere. He moves through dimensional gateways woven from fire and autumn leaves, pursuing a solitary goal known only to himself.

cards.name: Elowyn
cards.text: Ongoing: Adjacent locations have +1 Power.
cards.background: A formidable warrior-mage caught in the middle of a violent thunderstorm, Elowyn harnesses raw atmospheric energy. Clad in combat gear adorned with runes, she sprints across hostile terrain, shielding herself with concentrated plasma arcs while lightning splits the sky behind her.

cards.name: Malveris
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A majestic yet fearsome green-scaled dragon with membranous red wings, Malveris patrols the open skies above vast river valleys. Unlike ground-dwelling beasts, this territorial flyer surveys the lands below with a sharp predator's gaze, guarding its aerial dominion from all intruders.

cards.name: Thalindra
cards.text: Ongoing: Elarion Empire cards at this location get +2 Power.
cards.background: A beacon of radiant light and unwavering faith, Thalindra is a high paladin of the Elarion Empire. Clad in ancient, sanctified gold armor, she clutches her greatsword and looks upward in a moment of divine communion, channeling the celestial energy that bursts forth around her as she prepares to smite the enemies of the empire.

cards.name: Vyrnoth
cards.text: Chaos (3 turns): Burn chance = (6 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: An ancient, skeletal dragon, Vyrnoth is a haunting silhouette against a storm-ridden sky. Perched upon a desolate, rocky peak, it stands watch over a landscape of scorched, jagged trees and dying fires. Its empty eye sockets burn with a cold, malevolent intelligence, and its tattered wings crackle with residual necrotic energy.

cards.name: Odran Dreadmoor
cards.text: Muster: Play all "Odran Dreadmoor" cards from your deck here instantly.
cards.background: A sinister cultist and master of hounds for the Horde, Odran Dreadmoor maintains order through fear. Shirtless and covered in complex, dark sigils, he stands in a dilapidated barn, smiling cruelly as he holds back three snarling, muscular pitbulls on a thick leather leash. He controls his beasts through a twisted magical connection.

cards.name: Zevrak
cards.text: On Reveal: Remove abilities from all Ongoing cards at this location.
cards.background: An enigmatic and powerful archmage, Zevrak commands both the forces of destruction and submission. Clad in ornate black and gold robes and a protective mask, he stands on a stone platform within an icy cave. He holds a burning staff, looking down upon two kneeling, hulking demon thralls whose backs are cracked with molten lava fissures.

cards.name: Drusilla
cards.text: Ongoing: Cards played here are not revealed until the game ends.
cards.background: A spectral sorceress of profound sorrow and dark power, Drusilla drifts ethereally between realms. Appearing as a pale woman in an ornate, tattered black lace gown and a crown of dark flora, she clutches a single, dying purple rose. She is surrounded by a violent vortex of disintegrating black and purple petals that shatter reality as she passes.

cards.name: Skull of Xyveron
cards.text: Ongoing: Your other Ongoing abilities at this location trigger twice.
cards.background: An ancient, sentient artifact of necromancy, the Skull of Xyveron floats in a dark, rain-soaked ruin. It possesses a malevolent consciousness, glowing with an intense blue-green spectral flame and crackling with runic magic. It hovers just above the ground, illuminating the wet cobblestones with its eerie light as it seeks to enthrall the living.

cards.name: Rhazakar
cards.text: Chaos (2 turns): Burn chance = (10 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: The Eye of Rhazakar is a gateway to an ancient, primordial terror. A colossal, scaled reptilian eye with a slitted golden pupil sits imprisoned behind jagged stone slabs etched with glowing red runes. The runes pulse with volatile volcanic energy, hinting at the immense, fiery entity trapped within that is slowly breaking its seal.

cards.name: An unseen ranger
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A weary, pragmatic scout for a human kingdom, this unnamed ranger serves as a frontline guide in the cursed forests. Clad in a green tunic, leather brigandine, and a steel kettle helmet, he draws his bow, scanning the misty, twisted trees while a flock of ravens takes flight above, signaling unseen movement in the woods.

cards.name: Nightfang
cards.text: Muster: Play all "Nightfang" cards from your deck here instantly.
cards.background: Nightfang is an apex predator of the frozen north, a monstrous, black-furred wolf driven by a primal rage. His eyes glow with a haunting yellow light, and drool freezes in his open, fanged maw as he charges through a blizzard. The three arrows deeply embedded in his shoulder only fuel his relentless, furious assault.

cards.name: Carcasses of Hell
cards.text: Chaos (4 turns): Burn chance = (4 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: An eternal, writhing congregation of charred skeletal remains trapped within the blistering heart of a hellish inferno. These damned, reanimated bones claw desperately at the air and smoke, cursed to burn endlessly while dragging any unfortunate soul who wanders too close into the roaring flames with them.

cards.name: Rhaedric Ironmourne
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A commanding, fierce veteran lord of Elderveld, Rhaedric leads his heavy cavalry charges from the front lines. With his bald head, scarred visage, and broadsword held high, he rides a heavily armored warhorse past the stone ramparts of the realm's bastions, rallying his knights to defend their ancestral lands.

cards.name: Mage Morgana
cards.text: On Reveal: Repeat the On Reveal abilities of your other cards here.
cards.background: A volatile and tempestuous spellcaster, Morgana stands atop a jagged mountain precipice amid a gathering thunderstorm. Her hands crackle with high-voltage lightning while she simultaneously conjures and commands a swirling, luminous vortex of spirit-butterflies, channeling raw atmospheric chaos.

cards.name: Mage Lyssandra
cards.text: Ongoing: Protects your cards at this location from being destroyed.
cards.background: A master defensive battle-mage caught in the middle of a brutal military siege. Clad in elegant blue-and-white robes adorned with a crimson sash, Lyssandra projects a powerful kinetic force-shield from her palm, violently repelling charging enemy soldiers and sending them flying backward through the debris.

cards.name: Ysolde Blackshield
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A hardened, blood-splattered infantry officer of Elderveld fighting in the muddy trenches of a relentless war. Wearing studded leather armor over mail and bearing the physical scars of fierce skirmishes, she drives her shortsword downward with grim, absolute finality to finish a fallen adversary.

cards.name: Orvax the Troll
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A colossal, moss-grown mountain troll who terrorizes the wooded borders of Elderveld. Encased in natural stone plating and dragging a mutilated imperial soldier behind him like a broken toy, Orvax stalks through the autumn leaves past shattered supply carts and discarded shields.

cards.name: Hochreich Frontline
cards.text: Faction Bond: Power doubles if another Hochreich card is here.
cards.background: A disciplined and battle-hardened frontline regiment of the Hochreich military. Led by a fiercely shouting veteran captain sporting a plumed helmet and distinctive orange-and-silver tabards, these infantrymen advance through muddy terrain with leveled spears and drawn swords to hold the line against invading forces.

cards.name: Ravaria Frontline
cards.text: Faction Bond: Power doubles if another Ravaria card is here.
cards.background: The elite heavy cavalry vanguard of Ravaria, renowned for their thunderous charges across contested plains. Clad in gleaming full plate armor and bearing red-and-white shields emblazoned with the realm's iconic eagle crests, these mounted knights surge forward past distant stone keeps to shatter enemy formations.

cards.name: Tavric
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A scarred, no-nonsense mercenary fighter serving within the ranks of the Horde of the Carrion. With a blood-streaked brow and a shaved head, Tavric stands his ground amid the smoke and ruin of a chaotic battlefield, gripping a two-handed sword with cold, lethal focus as skirmishes rage around him.

cards.name: Nythrak
cards.text: On Reveal: Destroy the lowest-power enemy card here.
cards.background: An apocalyptic death-knight warlord of Kalthrone, Nythrak rides a skeletal nightmare stallion through a freezing, moonlit forest. Clad in jagged, dark iron armor and crowned with spikes, he wields a frost-rimed runeblade while glowing crimson eyes pierce the winter darkness, heralding an unstoppable wave of doom.

cards.name: Xaltheron
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A terrifying vanguard champion of Kalthrone, Xaltheron wears heavy, battle-scarred dark steel armor etched with a skeletal ribcage design. Amidst the chaos of a burning siege, he raises a heavy, blood-stained executioner's axe high above his head to ruthlessly crush a cornered enemy defender.

cards.name: Ash Ghouls
cards.text: Muster: Play all "Ash Ghouls" cards from your deck here instantly.
cards.background: A pack of volatile shadow-fiends born from the ashes of torched woodlands. These humanoid entities are composed of swirling dark smoke and smoldering embers, rushing relentlessly on four limbs through twisted winter trees with burning orange cores and razor-sharp claws.

cards.name: Maldrith
cards.text: Medic: Resurrect a destroyed non-Hero card to this location.
cards.background: A necromancer warlord of chilling power within Kalthrone, Maldrith strides across a snowy battlefield littered with fallen soldiers. Clad in ornate, spike-adorned dark steel armor and crowned with a spiked iron halo, he wields a staff topped with a blazing orb of yellow fire, commanding the frozen wastes with glowing blue eyes.

cards.name: Mosskin
cards.text: Ongoing: +1 Power to all other cards in this location.
cards.background: A peaceful nature spirit found deep within an enchanted autumnal forest. A faun maiden with delicate horns and rustic lower legs sits gracefully on a mossy log, playing a tranquil melody on a wooden flute while a tattooed human companion rests his head against her lap, finding brief solace far away from the wars of the realm.

cards.name: Bloatspider
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A grotesque insectoid monstrosity native to overgrown forest trails, the Bloatspider guards its territory with violent malice. Armed with spiked chitinous armor, multiple eyes, and a gaping maw filled with dripping fangs, it bursts from the ferns, having just upended an unsuspecting traveler's mushroom basket.

cards.name: Vulkas the Lion
cards.text: Chaos (3 turns): Burn chance = (7 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A ferocious hybrid predator soaring across a twilight sky, Vulkas combines the features of a majestic lion with draconic scales, horns, and tattered membranous wings. It breathes a torrent of searing orange flame down onto the dark pine forests below, turning the evening air into a furnace.

cards.name: Icemaw the Giant
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A massive, blue-skinned frost giant roaming the high, blizzard-swept mountain peaks. Adorned with bone necklaces and heavy pelts, he roars in primal fury while gripping a massive club fashioned from a beast's femur, relentlessly chasing fleeing scouts through deep snowdrifts.

cards.name: Undead Kalth. Soldier
cards.text: Muster: Play all "Undead Kalthrone Soldier" cards from your deck.
cards.background: An agile undead warrior of Kalthrone bursting out from a magical barrier of shattering blue ice. Clad in spiked iron armor with glowing cyan oculars, this frozen executioner leaps through a subterranean crypt, brandishing a wicked, double-bitted poleaxe to ambush any intruders.

cards.name: Vorthak
cards.text: Chaos (1 turn): Burn chance = (9 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A fierce, agile dragon with charcoal-black scales and glowing underbellies that reflect the sunset. Swooping low over a dense evergreen canopy, Vorthak prepares to unleash a wave of intense fire from its jaws, scanning the earth below for any moving target.

cards.name: Lizard Drok
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A reptilian humanoid warrior native to the high, snow-dusted mountain ridges. Clad in a leather harness, shoulder guard, and iron bracers, this cold-resistant predator stands poised on a snowy precipice, its yellow-scaled maw open wide in a sharp, menacing hiss against the stormy mountain backdrop.

cards.name: Kalthrone Horde
cards.text: Faction Bond: Power doubles if another Kalthrone card is here.
cards.background: An apocalyptic vanguard legion of the Kalthrone Horde marching through a desolate, freezing winter landscape. Led by a towering, horned dread-knight clad in rusted, skeletal plate armor and bearing a ragged banner of bones, this unstoppable undead army advances past burning ruins to claim the realm.

cards.name: Thessa
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A fierce and battle-hardened warrior woman of Elderveld, Thessa fights on the muddy frontline of a violent siege. Wearing a steel helmet with a flowing black crest and plate-reinforced armor, she grips a blood-stained battleaxe and a shield, holding her ground against opposing infantry.

cards.name: Ash Ghouls
cards.text: Muster: Play all "Ash Ghouls" cards from your deck here instantly.
cards.background: A pack of volatile shadow-fiends born from the ashes of torched woodlands. These humanoid entities are composed of swirling dark smoke and smoldering embers, rushing relentlessly on four limbs through twisted winter trees with burning orange cores and razor-sharp claws.

cards.name: Katerina
cards.text: Ongoing: Steal the text from a random enemy Ongoing card here.
cards.background: A powerful and calculating noble sorceress of Ravaria, Katerina stands amidst the ancient, ivy-covered ruins of a stone fortress. Wearing an opulent crimson dress and a golden crown, she calmly commands a swarm of glowing green spirit-snakes that coil protectively around her.

cards.name: Zorgrim
cards.text: Chaos (1 turn): Burn chance = (12 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A colossal, white-scaled ancient dragon known as a fortress-breaker, Zorgrim lays waste to mountain strongholds. Rearing up against a sunset sky, the massive beast casually shatters a stone watchtower with its crushing claws, roaring triumphantly as debris and defenders scatter.

cards.name: Cheapy
cards.text: Spy: Play on enemy side. Copy the last card they played into your hand.
cards.background: A nimble and cunning rogue operating out of a shadowy forest encampment. Crouched alertly atop a stack of wooden supply crates near a glowing campfire, she looks back over her shoulder with a playful smirk while casually spinning a throwing dagger in her hand.

cards.name: Werewolf
cards.text: Muster: Play all "Werewolf" cards from your deck here instantly.
cards.background: An apex lycanthropic predator of the deep, misty pinewoods. The massive, muscular beast presses its clawed hand against a thick, mossy tree trunk, baring its razor-sharp teeth and glaring with fierce, amber eyes as it stalks unseen travelers through the fog.

cards.name: Bear
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A savage berserker champion fighting within the Horde of the Carrion. Wearing the skull and pelt of a dire bear over his scarred, tattooed body, he wades waist-deep into a muddy forest skirmish, swinging a battleaxe and brandishing a round shield while fending off snapping goblins.

cards.name: Sgt. Drustan Nightscar
cards.text: Ongoing: Your cards with No Ability at this location have +2 Power.
cards.background: A weathered and indomitable frontline sergeant of Elderveld, Drustan leads his men through a brutal, rain-soaked melee in the shadow of mountain peaks. Clad in dented steel armor and bearing a lion-crested shield, he screams a battle cry while raising a bloodied hand axe to strike down an enemy combatant.

cards.name: General Eldran
cards.text: Ongoing: Your other Ongoing cards at this location have +2 Power.
cards.background: A legendary, high-ranking general of the Elarion Empire, Eldran stands proudly upon a snowy mountain precipice overlooking distant imperial spires. Clad in ornate, gold-engraved plate armor adorned with majestic stag antlers and holding a massive, finely-crafted broadsword, he embodies the unyielding majesty and strength of his empire.

cards.name: Soul Whale
cards.text: Move: Can move to an adjacent location once per game.
cards.background: A majestic, ethereal leviathan drifting through the subterranean abyss of deep crystal caverns. Glowing with a soft celestial light and surrounded by floating stardust, this mystical entity glides silently over dark chasms and stalagmites as a lone traveler looks on in awe.

cards.name: Tharic
cards.text: On Reveal: Destroy a random enemy card at this location.
cards.background: A sadistic pyromancer and torturer within the Horde of the Carrion. With long dark hair and a cruel, scarred smirk, Tharic uses his blazing touch to immolate an enemy knight in full armor outside a burning fortress, taking sadistic pleasure in the chaos.

cards.name: Princess Corvella
cards.text: Medic: Resurrect a non-Hero card to this location.
cards.background: The poised and elegant royal heir of Elderveld, resting within her castle hall. Adorned in a rich blue and white velvet gown, an ermine-trimmed crimson cloak, and a golden crown, she holds a jeweled scepter while an advisor's hand rests reassuringly upon her shoulder.

cards.name: Ser Mstislav Volkhvich
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A high knight-commander of Ravaria on a solemn patrol through a gloomy, twisted forest. Clad in dark, ornate plate armor with winged helm and a flowing crimson cape, he bears the realm's banner on horseback while keeping his broadsword ready for unseen threats.

cards.name: Magma Titan
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A colossal elemental terror forged from molten rock and living fire. Towering over a volcanic wasteland of lava rivers and erupting peaks, the Titan's body is split by glowing fissures of intense heat as it flexes its heavy, destructive stone claws.

cards.name: Undead Kalth. Soldier
cards.text: Muster: Play all "Undead Kalthrone Soldier" cards from your deck.
cards.background: A reanimated foot soldier of Kalthrone stepping through a shimmering dimensional portal within a ruined fortress. Clad in spiked iron armor and a helm over its skull, this spectral-touched warrior wields a spiked mace and shield, backed by phantom hands reaching from the void.

cards.name: Cinderteeth
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A ferocious berserker champion of the Horde, known for his unbridled rage on the battlefield. Bare-chested with tribal tattoos, braided red hair, and a bear-fur pelt, Cinderteeth leaps through the smoke and fire of a destroyed settlement, swinging a massive, rune-etched battleaxe.

cards.name: Ulyana
cards.text: On Reveal: Draw a card from your deck.
cards.background: A studious young scholar and aspiring spellcaster relaxing in a cozy, book-lined library. Seated comfortably in a red armchair with a warm fireplace nearby, she watches as an intricate ribbon of glowing blue magic gracefully rises from the pages of her open tome.

cards.name: Varyena
cards.text: Ongoing: Enemy cards played here lose 1 Power.
cards.background: An enigmatic, mystical fae entity drifting through the foggy ruins of an ancient courtyard. With translucent, golden-glowing butterfly wings and a blindfold over her eyes, she weaves streams of magical stardust and light through the air with elegant gestures.

cards.name: Sweetboy the Giant
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: Despite his ironic moniker, Sweetboy is a towering, brutal brute of the wilderness. Gripping a massive spiked club, he looms menacingly over a fully-armored knight in a mountain pass, casting a giant shadow across the landscape as a ruined castle crumbles in the background.

cards.name: Soulroot
cards.text: Chaos (4 turns): Burn chance = (5 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A monstrous, carnivorous plant entity rooted in a dark, blighted valley. The Soulroot features a massive, gaping crimson maw dripping with digestive slime and a winding stem studded with glowing yellow pods that lure unsuspecting wanderers into its trap.

cards.name: Travtin the Blades
cards.text: Spy: Play on enemy side. Draw 2 cards.
cards.background: An elite woodland scout and dual-wielding warrior. With intricate facial markings and braided hair, Travtin stands atop a moss-covered log in a misty forest, gripping a curved shortsword and a rune-carved shield while an ancient ruin looms in the background.

cards.name: Foresterian Female
cards.text: Ongoing: +1 Power for each card currently in your hand.
cards.background: A lethal dryad archer blending seamlessly into the autumnal woodlands. Her body and hair are woven entirely from vines, leaves, and moss. Drawing a rustic wooden bow strung with living branches, she guards the forest canopy as golden and red leaves drift through the air.

cards.name: Gormuth
cards.text: Medic: Resurrect an enemy's destroyed card to your side.
cards.background: A powerful vampire lord resting within his cavernous subterranean domain. Bald and pale with crimson-stained lips, Gormuth stands open-armed on a rocky ledge beneath a swarm of circling bats, wearing an ornate golden collar and a deep red crimson skirt.

cards.name: Werewolf
cards.text: Muster: Play all "Werewolf" cards from your deck here instantly.
cards.background: A terrifying lycanthropic terror perched atop a high church spire under the glow of a crescent moon. Baring its fangs and glowing red eyes, this massive, smoky beast looms over a medieval village nestled in the mountain valley, casting fear into the hearts of the townsfolk.

cards.name: Drakhar
cards.text: Chaos (2 turns): Burn chance = (11 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A fearsome black-scaled dragon of apocalyptic fury. Standing atop a scorched volcanic peak amidst a raging forest fire, Drakhar arches its spiked neck and tattered wings toward the smoke-filled sky, surveying the devastation left in its wake.

cards.name: Prince Radomir
cards.text: Faction Bond: Power doubles if another Ravaria card is here.
cards.background: A resolute royal commander of Ravaria fighting on the front lines during a mystical event. Clad in durable chainmail, leather armor, and a flowing crimson cloak, Prince Radomir grips a broadsword defensively on a rocky cliffside beneath a dramatic solar eclipse and a sky choked with ominous ravens.

cards.name: Swamp Vampire
cards.text: Move: Move a random enemy card to another location.
cards.background: A grotesque, feral vampire variant adapted to the decaying swamplands. Crouched menacingly on a mossy stone outcropping amid stagnant waters and gnarled trees, this muscular, bat-winged creature bares its razor-sharp teeth with glowing yellow eyes, hunting prey in the eternal fog.

cards.name: Thief Marro
cards.text: Spy: Play on enemy side. Draw 1 card, steal 1 from their deck.
cards.background: A cunning and elusive rogue caught mid-heist in a damp stone dungeon. Clad in dark leather armor and a hooded cloak, Marro wields a longsword and a dagger while a cascade of magical golden coins floats and spins around her in the dim light.

cards.name: Queen Elvira

cards.background: The regal and magically gifted elven queen of Elderveld, presiding over her court. Draped in an opulent, flowing blue-and-silver gown with braided platinum hair, Queen Elvira holds a luminous crystal staff inside a grand hall illuminated by magical chandeliers and surrounded by her loyal subjects.

cards.name: Rampage

cards.name: Gravebound Wolves

cards.name: Savage

cards.background: A chimeric shadow-predator stalking across a wooden fence under the cover of a crescent moon. Combining the agile body of a black panther with leathery bat wings, horns, and glowing green eyes, it hunts silently among the night-flying moths.

cards.name: Werewolf
cards.text: Muster: Play all "Werewolf" cards from your deck here instantly.
cards.background: The alpha of a dense, misty pinewood forest, leading a pack of lurking shadows. Crouched low over the gnarled roots of a giant tree, the creature bares its fangs and flexes its lethal claws as a full moon pierces the dark canopy.

cards.name: Eryc Darkwarden
cards.text: Faction Bond: Power doubles if another Elderveld card is here.
cards.background: A valiant knight-commander of Elderveld fighting on a stormy, wave-lashed coastal battlefield. Clad in gleaming steel armor and riding a warhorse, Eryc uses his runic broadsword to shatter the shell of a monstrous giant red crab while more of the crustacean horrors swarm from the surf.

cards.name: Elderveld Archers

cards.name: Knight Jughead

cards.name: Bounty Hunter

cards.name: Warmongrel
cards.text: Faction Bond: Power doubles if another Ravaria card is here.
cards.background: A brutal, dragon-blooded warlord and vanguard champion of Ravaria. Clad in heavy, scaled metallic armor with matching dragon-styled pauldrons and a spiked shield, he walks across a volcanic wasteland with a smoking volcano behind him, carrying a massive, claw-adorned battleaxe.

cards.name: John the Wolf
cards.text: Faction Bond: Power doubles if another Elderveld card is here.
cards.background: A legendary knight of the Elderveld Empire depicted in a textured watercolor medium. With long dark hair and a determined expression, he wears intricately engraved steel plate armor featuring a crescent moon motif, standing beneath a brilliant silver crescent moon against a swirling cosmic night sky.

cards.name: The Weeping Kelp
cards.text: Chaos (4 turns): Burn chance = (4 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A haunting, ethereal sea-spirit haunting a rocky coastal cliffside. Cloaked in an endless cascade of dark, undulating tentacle-like hair, it features a pale porcelain mask adorned with three glowing yellow eyes, standing silently above the crashing gray waves.

cards.name: Ruk, the Bone-Breaker
cards.text: Chaos (2 turns): Burn chance = (6 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A ferocious gargoyle-demon prowling a dark, misty woodland under the light of a full moon. Featuring leathery green skin, curved horns, and tattered membranous wings, it crouches low over mossy terrain, baring sharp claws and glowing red eyes.

cards.name: Mantis
cards.text: Ongoing: Opponent's On Reveal abilities do not trigger here.
cards.background: A bizarre and surreal hybrid insectoid creature standing within a dense, mossy jungle clearing. Featuring a slender blue body, mantis-like forelegs, and large butterfly wings decorated with hypnotic, eye-like red patterns, it gazes forward with an eerie, intelligent stillness.

cards.name: Marrow-Gnaw
cards.text: Chaos (3 turns): Burn chance = (5 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A grotesque cave-dwelling scavenger haunting a subterranean bone pit. Wearing a tattered, fur-lined hood, the mutated creature crouches on the rocky floor, wielding a massive, jagged scythe wrapped in chains while drooling over piles of scattered skeletal remains.

cards.name: Conjurer
cards.text: Medic: Resurrect a random non-Hero card to your hand.
cards.background: A mysterious and reclusive magic-user standing in a vibrant field of red poppies under a stormy sky. Clad in a tattered, dark hooded cloak, the conjurer holds an arcane staff topped with a jagged blade and dark crystal, communing with unseen forces at the edge of a pine forest.

cards.name: Unknown Slayer
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A heavily armored and terrifying executioner-warrior charging through the crumbling stone ruins of an ancient arena. Clad in dark, glowing plate armor etched with fiery red cracks and horned helm, he wields a glowing blue-and-red energy sword and a matching rune-inscribed shield.

cards.name: Vulture
cards.text: On Reveal: Copy the text of an enemy Ongoing card here.
cards.background: A skeletal avian monstrosity haunting the decaying courtyards of a ruined fortress. With massive feathered wings, a bird skull head with glowing red eyes, and bone-adorned robes, this grim creature grips a skeletal staff tipped with a skull, presiding over a field of wild red blossoms.

cards.name: Cagehead
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A brutally strong gladiatorial combatant fighting in a chaotic dirt arena. Bare-chested and heavily scarred, with thick iron chains wrapped around his arms and legs, he wears a heavy iron-grate cage over his head and brandishes two massive spiked war hammers.

cards.name: Cernunnos' Shadow
cards.text: Chaos (3 turns): Burn chance = (5 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A shadowy, long-limbed forest entity creeping near a stone fortress wall at night. Featuring glowing white eyes and an elaborate crown woven from thorny branches and vines, it looms menacingly beside a crackling bonfire amid the smoke and ruins.

cards.name: Vespera of the Pyre
cards.text: Chaos (1 turn): Burn chance = (11 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A apocalyptic skeletal dragon and elemental titan rising from a boiling purple ocean. Encased in charred bone armor crackling with red-and-blue lightning, it roars beneath a churning sky filled with countless watchful eyes.

cards.name: Snakehead
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A muscular reptilian humanoid warrior standing atop the rubble of a destroyed temple. Featuring deep green scales, a wide cobra hood, yellow underbelly plates, and leather combat harness with bracers, he glares forward with sharp, predatory eyes and a flickering forked tongue.

cards.name: Gisela
cards.text: Faction Bond: Power doubles if another Hochreich card is here.
cards.background: A fierce and battle-scarred female warrior of Hochreich standing inside a torch-lit castle armory. Bearing numerous scars across her face and body, she wears dark armored attire with a distinctive horned-skull pauldron, gripping a broadsword while a banner bearing the realm's crest hangs behind her.

cards.name: Master of Arcana
cards.text: Ongoing: Your On Reveal abilities at this location trigger twice.
cards.background: A powerful, cephalopod-headed grand magus researching ancient tomes inside a massive, multi-tiered library. Clad in dark, spiked robes and a hooded cloak, he reads from an open book glowing with intense green arcane energy, surrounded by towering stacks of ancient manuscripts.

cards.name: Arc Warrior
cards.text: Ongoing: Shields all your cards at this location from destruction.
cards.background: A spectral, frost-infused wraith haunting the sub-zero corridors of an ancient ice crypt. Encased in glowing blue ethereal armor and a hooded shroud, this chilling apparition glides forward with blinding white eyes amidst drifting frost and ancient runes carved into the pillars.

cards.name: Dragon Father
cards.text: Chaos (2 turns): Burn chance = (9 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: An ancient and terrifying undead sovereign hovering above a snow-covered mountain pass. Clad in ornate golden spiked plate armor, a ragged red royal cloak, and a jagged crown atop a skeletal skull face, he grips a massive rune-etched greatsword and a spiked shield.

cards.name: Bjorn Iron-Hide
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A resilient and weathered northern warrior standing steadfast amidst a blinding snowstorm in the mountain peaks. Dressed in heavily battered, scarred plate armor, a fur-trimmed hood, and carrying a wooden round shield bearing a skull emblem alongside a bloodied battleaxe.

cards.name: Lord Malakor
cards.text: Chaos (2 turns): Burn chance = (7 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A legendary headless horseman charging along a treacherous, misty mountain ridge at sunset. Clad in black-and-red demonic spiked armor with smoke rising from his neck collar, he wields a glowing fiery blade while riding a hellish warhorse with blazing orange-and-blue hooves.

cards.name: Lord Zealot
cards.text: On Reveal: Destroy all enemy units here with 2 or less Power.
cards.background: A monstrous gargoyle-like inquisitor crouching on a high stone ledge inside a gothic cathedral. With leathery wings, sharp horns, and jagged claws, he keeps watch over the twisting stairwells and stained-glass windows from the shadows.

cards.name: Paladin the Kingslayer
cards.text: Hero: Immune to all special effects, abilities, and destroys.
cards.background: A grim and ominous knight standing atop a rocky precipice beneath a stormy sky. Clad in dark, intricately engraved full plate armor with a bird-styled winged helm, he rests his hands atop the hilt of a heavy rune-inscribed sword planted firmly in the ground.

cards.name: Gorgaroth
cards.text: Chaos (2 turns): Burn chance = (7 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A savage, heavily armored reptilian beast stalking through the darkness. Featuring thick, jagged scales, massive curling horns, glowing red eyes, and razor-sharp claws, this monstrous predator prowls low to the ground in search of prey.

cards.name: Split-Jaw
cards.text: Chaos (3 turns): Burn chance = (5 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A horrific, mutated humanoid entity lurking within a dense, misty forest. Possessing a pale, smooth body and a terrifying vertical maw that splits straight down its chest lined with rows of sharp teeth, it stands eerily still among the ferns and trees.

cards.name: Amalgam of Torment
cards.text: Chaos (3 turns): Burn chance = (6 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A grotesque multi-limbed abomination crafted from fused flesh and tormented souls within a dungeon. Crawling on all fours with multiple clawed arms, agonized faces protruding from its body, and a writhing flesh-tentacle, it embodies pure psychological horror.

cards.name: Starbound
cards.text: Ongoing: Adjacent locations gain +2 Power.
cards.background: A mystical wanderer standing in a freezing mountain pass, wielding weapons crackling with raw lightning. Clad in weathered, dented armor with a cloth hood and face wrap, he stands guard while an eerie cosmic entity sits upon a tentacled stone throne in the misty background.

cards.name: Demon God
cards.text: Chaos (1 turn): Burn chance = (12 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A supreme lord of the abyss soaring through a twin-mooned night sky atop a colossal, fire-breathing dragon. Clad in glowing, lava-veined black armor and tattered winged capes, he wields a massive double-bitted axe wreathed in roaring orange and blue flames above a distant fortress.

cards.name: Paladin Cassian
cards.text: Hero: Immune to all special effects, abilities, and destroys.
cards.background: A noble and ethereal paladin standing upon a high cloud formation beneath a starry, cosmic night sky. Clad in intricately engraved dark-steel plate armor featuring bird motifs and a flowing dark cape with golden trim, he rests his hands over the hilt of a rune-inscribed broadsword planted firmly before him.

cards.name: Sunk Crypt
cards.text: Medic: Resurrect a destroyed card to this location with +2 Power.
cards.background: A haunting undead guardian emerging from the flooded, rubble-strewn ruins of an underground crypt. Encased in weathered plate armor and a tattered crimson hood, the skeletal warrior radiates an intense green necrotic glow from its eye sockets and grips a glowing green-veined blade amidst swirling spirits.

cards.name: Ghost of Pharaoh
cards.text: Faction Bond: Power doubles if another Hochreich card is here.
cards.background: A resurrected royal spectre hovering above an ancient ritual stone ring in the desert sands. Clad in ornate, gold-engraved pharaonic armor and a regal crown adorned with a glowing purple crystal, he clutches a matching staff of office against a backdrop of towering pyramids and the Sphinx at sunset.

cards.name: Void-Knight
cards.text: On Reveal: Destroy the highest enemy card here if their total > 10.
cards.background: A fearsome champion touched by the void, patrolling a gothic stone balcony overlooking a vaulted hall. Clad in dark metallic armor fused with pulsating purple flesh and horned helmet, he wields a massive, jagged greatsword crackling with violet lightning.

cards.name: Obsidian
cards.text: Chaos (1 turn): Burn chance = (10 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A colossal elemental golem hewn from jagged volcanic rock and dark crystal. Covered in creeping vines and dripping with dark sludge, its monolithic body features a single, blazing purple eye in the center of its chest that projects an intense, blinding beam of violet light.

cards.name: Cerberus
cards.text: Chaos (2 turns): Burn chance = (9 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A terrifying three-headed hound of the underworld standing amidst a landscape of active volcanoes and flowing lava. Each head commands a primal element—spewing crackling purple lightning, freezing blue frost, and roaring orange fire—while bound in heavy iron chains.

cards.name: Agony of Death
cards.text: Chaos (4 turns): Burn chance = (5 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A wretched, multi-headed undead abomination kneeling in despair upon desolate ground. With matted dark hair, emaciated skeletal frames, and tattered rags, it clutches a massive rune-etched sword that pulses with a sickly green ethereal light driven into the earth.

cards.name: Lilith the Devil
cards.text: On Reveal: Steal 2 Power from every enemy card at this location.
cards.background: A seductive and lethal arch-demon striding through a desolate, rocky wasteland surrounded by ancient fortress ruins. With leathery dark wings, small curling horns, and dark spiked leather armor glowing with purple energy, she holds a crackling violet-lightning sword in her hand.

cards.name: Nebula
cards.text: Chaos (1 turn): Burn chance = (11 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A cosmic sovereign seated upon an imposing throne carved from dark stone and tentacles, floating amidst a swirling galaxy. With pale skin, glowing red eyes, intricate body runes, and massive curved ram horns, she holds a brilliant, pulsing pink-red star crystal in her palm.

cards.name: Sylverra the Eternal
cards.text: Ongoing: Gives all cards in your hand +1 Power.
cards.background: A supreme cosmic sorceress hovering gracefully above a congregation of kneeling ethereal spirits. Clad in dark leather combat attire and a flowing cape against a backdrop of distant galaxies, she commands a green swirling magical portal in one hand and a sphere of captive souls in the other.

cards.name: Varnok
cards.text: On Reveal: Summon two 2-Power Flame Demons to this location.
cards.background: A powerful dark sorcerer standing within a subterranean cavern before a swirling portal of fire and lightning. Clad in ornate dark robes with gold embroidery and a mask, he wields a staff topped with a blazing orb while two horned, ash-crusted demons kneel in submission at his feet.

cards.name: Fire Serpent
cards.text: Chaos (1 turn): Burn chance = (10 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A colossal, magma-veined dragon perched atop a jagged volcanic peak overlooking a sea of flowing lava. Its dark scales crack with molten fire and ancient glowing runes, sending plumes of thick smoke into the turbulent sky above.

cards.name: Goldenfur
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A proud, athletic feline humanoid warrior standing against a backdrop of glowing sunset mountain peaks. Adorned in polished gold-and-silver armor with blue gem accents, a golden tiara, and flowing reddish-brown hair, she embodies both grace and untamed strength.

cards.name: Lady Cassia
cards.text: Faction Bond: Power doubles if another Elarion card is here.
cards.background: A graceful and noble high-ranking aristocrat of the Elarion Empire standing on a marble balcony overlooking a sprawling fantasy city at sunset. Dressed in an elegant white-and-gold gown with intricate jeweled trimming and an elaborate crown, she holds a delicate staff topped with a glowing blue crystal.

cards.name: Behemoth
cards.text: Chaos (1 turn): Burn chance = (11 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A towering, decaying titan stumbling across a war-torn settlement amid a chaotic army. Its skeletal frame is entirely riddled with hundreds of arrows and tattered banners, featuring a terrifying horned skull face with multiple eyes glaring through the gloom.

cards.name: Devil
cards.text: Move: Can move to an adjacent location once per game.
cards.background: A bizarre and surreal subterranean creature perched on a mossy rock inside an illuminated crystal cave. Covered in pale, soft fur, it features a bulbous pink snout, oversized ears, and a single prominent cyclopean eye that gazes curiously into the damp cavern depths.

cards.name: Winged Herald
cards.text: Ongoing: Cards played here gain +1 Power upon reveal.
cards.background: A fierce celestial warrior with massive black feathered wings soaring above a burning medieval battlefield. Bare-chested and covered in tribal tattoos with ornate armor bracers, he plunges downward while gripping a massive broadsword wreathed in roaring, magical flames.

cards.name: Stalker
cards.text: On Reveal: Destroy the enemy's weakest card at this location.
cards.background: A sinister operative standing amidst the burning ruins of a besieged fortress under a full moon. Clad in dark leather armor, a hooded cloak, and spiked bracers, his arms have mutated into massive, crimson-veined organic claws dripping with lethal intent.

cards.name: Vanguard of Hochreich
cards.text: Faction Bond: Power doubles if another Hochreich card is here.
cards.background: A valiant vanguard knight of Hochreich charging across a battlefield atop a powerful black warhorse. Clad in intricate steel-and-gold plate armor and a winged helm, she bears a lion-crested shield and wields a deadly spear wreathed in brilliant, roaring flames.

cards.name: Kaiden
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: A shadowy, hooded sentinel standing motionless amidst the desolate and foggy ruins of a forgotten gothic town. Cloaked in tattered black rags that blend into the mist, he grips a heavy broadsword crackling with faint, erratic arcs of white lightning.

cards.name: Clockwork
cards.text: Relic: Ongoing - Gives all your mechanical and construct cards +2 Power.
cards.background: A massive, steam-powered automaton constructed from ancient brass and bronze plates, standing triumphantly atop a network of massive rotating gears. Steam billows from its helmet and chest vents while its mechanical right hand spins a lethal circular saw and its left fist charges a glowing energy core within a subterranean dungeon.

cards.name: Warten the Vampire Lord
cards.text: On Reveal: Destroy a friendly card here to gain its Power.
cards.background: A powerful, long-lived vampire lord standing upon a treacherous, stormy mountain cliffside overlooking his gothic castle. Clad in intricately engraved dark plate armor with a crimson sash and a tattered black cloak, he wields a sinister sword glowing with vibrant purple runes under a lightning-lit sky.

cards.name: Leviathan
cards.text: Chaos (1 turn): Burn chance = (12 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: An apocalyptic nightmare realm where skeletal, glowing red sharks swim through a bloody, crimson-tinted sky above a ruined landscape. Below, countless hands rise from the earth while a macabre crucifix structure towers over a ruined bridge under a blood moon.

cards.name: Terror of Worlds
cards.text: Chaos (1 turn): Burn chance = (13 / Side Total) * 100.
cards.background: A colossal, heavily armored dragon-like behemoth crouched defensively amidst a shattered, crystal-spiked volcanic wasteland. Covered in massive white horns, jagged obsidian spikes across its back and wings, and glowing yellow eyes, it radiates an unstoppable, world-ending fury.

cards.name: Blobeye
cards.text: No Ability.
cards.background: Eye monster with bat wings that lives in labyrint dimension.
